accepted.quote: H.R. 839 is an unnecessary attack on science-based conservation that would undermine voluntary, market-driven habitat protection in one of the most threatened ecosystems on the planet.
accepted.rationale: The quote opposes H.R. 839 because it would undermine habitat protection, indicating strong support for public lands conservation.

accepted.quote: The bill would jeopardize essential habitat for vulnerable species and block proven conservation tools that respect private property rights while addressing the biodiversity crisis facing grassland ecosystems.
accepted.rationale: The quote opposes the bill for harming essential habitat for vulnerable species, indicating support for wildlife protection.
